controls: Same physical SDF/camera/world/humans/start/goal, Nav2 weights and speed limits. Headless GPU capture for B and C; baseline had a GUI. No forced path, waypoint, or contact-based reward.
comparison_limits: One seed, stochastic controller, baseline wall performance not comparable due to GUI; B vs C isolates inflation. A vs B changes URDF/TF plus footprint jointly.
criteria: Preserve every attempt; no automatic retries or overwrite.
Audit live Nav2 parameters, frozen inputs, raw paired depth and actual static TF.
Goal success is separate from crossing the narrow H5-H6 opening.
Gate crossing evaluated against time-matched moving human positions; report stationary-pair qualification.
Conservative swept-disc clearance from recorded 50 Hz poses is descriptive; native contact force is unavailable.
